notes.title: Patch!
notes.content:
Hi Everyone!

Got a small patch to address some issues.

[list]
[*] Added an instructional prompt for aiming and shooting.
[*] Fixed a cutscene that became bugged if Mr. Willickers is burnt.
[/list]

Hope you enjoy the game! Thanks!
